acquire.en: Young children acquire language without any formal teaching.
acquire.zh: 幼儿不需要正规教学就能习得语言。

obtain.en: Researchers obtained the data from hospitals in three different countries.
obtain.zh: 研究者从三个不同国家的医院获得了这些数据。

achieve.en: The country hopes to achieve its target of zero emissions by 2050.
achieve.zh: 这个国家希望到 2050 年实现零排放目标。

attain.en: Few birds of this species attain full adult size before their second year.
attain.zh: 这种鸟大多要到第二年以后才能长到成年体型。

accomplish.en: The team accomplished the task with very limited equipment and funding.
accomplish.zh: 团队在设备和资金都很有限的情况下完成了任务。

adapt.en: Many species adapt quickly to changes in temperature.
adapt.zh: 许多物种能很快适应温度变化。

adapt.en: The novel was adapted for television and watched by millions of people.
adapt.zh: 这部小说被改编成电视剧,有数百万人观看。

adjust.en: It takes the eyes several minutes to adjust to the dark.
adjust.zh: 眼睛需要几分钟才能适应黑暗。

modify.en: Scientists have modified the crop so that it needs less water.
modify.zh: 科学家对这种作物进行了改良,使它需要的水更少。

alter.en: Human activity has greatly altered the shape of the coastline.
alter.zh: 人类活动极大地改变了海岸线的形状。

enhance.en: Good lighting can enhance the appearance of a museum's collection.
enhance.zh: 良好的照明能提升博物馆藏品的观感。

improve.en: Planting trees can improve air quality in crowded city centres.
improve.zh: 植树可以改善拥挤市中心的空气质量。

boost.en: Tourism has helped to boost the local economy in recent years.
boost.zh: 近年来,旅游业推动了当地经济的发展。

boost.en: The new railway gave a major boost to trade between the two cities.
boost.zh: 新铁路大大推动了两座城市之间的贸易。

promote.en: Regular walking can promote better sleep and a healthier heart.
promote.zh: 经常散步可以促进睡眠,让心脏更健康。

promote.en: She was promoted to head of the department after only three years.
promote.zh: 仅仅三年后,她就被提拔为部门负责人。

facilitate.en: The new canal facilitated the movement of goods between the two regions.
facilitate.zh: 新运河使两个地区之间的货物运输更加便利。

foster.en: Group projects can foster cooperation and communication among students.
foster.zh: 小组项目可以培养学生的合作和沟通能力。

cultivate.en: Schools should cultivate curiosity as well as teach basic skills.
cultivate.zh: 学校既要传授基本技能,也要培养好奇心。

cultivate.en: Local farmers cultivate rice on narrow steps cut into the hillside.
cultivate.zh: 当地农民在山坡上开凿的狭窄梯田里种植水稻。

nurture.en: Good teachers nurture the natural abilities of every child in the class.
nurture.zh: 好老师会培育班上每个孩子的天赋。

stimulate.en: Lower taxes may stimulate investment in small businesses.
stimulate.zh: 减税可能刺激对小企业的投资。

motivate.en: Praise can motivate students more effectively than the threat of punishment.
motivate.zh: 表扬比惩罚的威胁更能有效地激励学生。

encourage.en: Cheap public transport may encourage people to leave their cars at home.
encourage.zh: 便宜的公共交通可能鼓励人们不开车出行。

inhibit.en: Certain chemicals in the leaves inhibit the growth of nearby plants.
inhibit.zh: 叶子中的某些化学物质会抑制附近植物的生长。

hinder.en: Poor roads continue to hinder the development of the region's economy.
hinder.zh: 糟糕的道路继续阻碍该地区的经济发展。

impede.en: Fallen trees can impede the flow of water along the river.
impede.zh: 倒下的树木可能妨碍河水流动。

hamper.en: Bad weather hampered efforts to rescue the crew of the ship.
hamper.zh: 恶劣天气妨碍了营救船员的工作。

restrict.en: The new rules restrict the number of boats allowed on the lake.
restrict.zh: 新规定限制了湖上允许通行的船只数量。

constrain.en: A lack of funding has constrained research in this field for many years.
constrain.zh: 多年来,资金短缺一直制约着这一领域的研究。

limit.en: Many cities now limit the use of cars in their historic centres.
limit.zh: 现在许多城市限制在历史城区使用汽车。

limit.en: There is a limit to how much information the brain can process.
limit.zh: 大脑能处理的信息量是有限度的。

prohibit.en: The law prohibits the sale of these birds and their eggs.
prohibit.zh: 法律禁止出售这些鸟及其蛋。

ban.en: Several countries have banned the use of this pesticide on farms.
ban.zh: 几个国家已经禁止在农场使用这种农药。

ban.en: A ban on hunting has allowed the number of whales to recover.
ban.zh: 禁猎令使鲸鱼的数量得以恢复。

prevent.en: Washing hands regularly helps to prevent the spread of infection.
prevent.zh: 经常洗手有助于防止感染传播。

avoid.en: Some animals move only at night to avoid the heat of the sun.
avoid.zh: 有些动物只在夜间活动,以避开太阳的炎热。

eliminate.en: Better design could eliminate most of the waste from the production process.
eliminate.zh: 更好的设计可以消除生产过程中的大部分浪费。

eradicate.en: A global vaccination programme helped to eradicate smallpox in the 1970s.
eradicate.zh: 全球疫苗接种计划帮助在 20 世纪 70 年代根除了天花。

reduce.en: Insulating older homes could greatly reduce the amount of energy they use.
reduce.zh: 给老房子加装隔热层可以大大减少能源消耗。

minimise.en: Engineers tried to minimise the effect of the dam on local wildlife.
minimise.zh: 工程师努力把大坝对当地野生动物的影响降到最低。

maximise.en: Farmers plant crops in rows to maximise the amount of sunlight they get.
maximise.zh: 农民成行种植作物,以最大限度地获得阳光。

mitigate.en: Planting trees along rivers can mitigate the effects of flooding.
mitigate.zh: 沿河植树可以减轻洪水的影响。

alleviate.en: The new medicine can alleviate pain without causing drowsiness.
alleviate.zh: 这种新药可以缓解疼痛,而且不会让人犯困。

relieve.en: Additional bus services were introduced to relieve pressure on the railway.
relieve.zh: 增设公交线路是为了缓解铁路的压力。

tackle.en: Governments must work together to tackle the problem of plastic waste.
tackle.zh: 各国政府必须共同努力,解决塑料垃圾问题。

address.en: The report fails to address the causes of poverty in rural areas.
address.zh: 这份报告未能处理农村贫困的根源。

cope-with.en: Older cities were not designed to cope with so many cars.
cope-with.zh: 老城市在设计时并没有考虑如何应对这么多汽车。

deal-with.en: Some schools have trained staff to deal with students' mental health problems.
deal-with.zh: 一些学校培训了教职工来处理学生的心理健康问题。

resolve.en: Scientists hope the new data will resolve the long debate about the fossils.
resolve.zh: 科学家希望新数据能解决关于这些化石的长期争论。

implement.en: The government plans to implement the new policy over the next five years.
implement.zh: 政府计划在未来五年内实施这项新政策。

execute.en: Robots can execute the same task thousands of times without making an error.
execute.zh: 机器人能够数千次执行同一任务而不出差错。

execute.en: The rebel leaders were captured and executed by order of the king.
execute.zh: 叛军领袖被捕后,由国王下令处决。

conduct.en: The team conducted a survey of over two thousand households.
conduct.zh: 研究团队对两千多户家庭进行了调查。

undertake.en: The museum has undertaken a major study of its early collections.
undertake.zh: 博物馆对其早期藏品开展了一项大型研究。

pursue.en: More women are now choosing to pursue careers in engineering.
pursue.zh: 现在越来越多的女性选择从事工程类职业。

establish.en: The first European settlers established a small colony on the coast.
establish.zh: 最早的欧洲定居者在海岸建立了一个小殖民地。

found.en: The university was founded in the nineteenth century by a group of local merchants.
found.zh: 这所大学由一群当地商人创立于十九世纪。

initiate.en: The government initiated a programme to bring clean water to rural areas.
initiate.zh: 政府发起了一项计划,为农村地区提供清洁用水。

launch.en: The agency plans to launch a new satellite to study the oceans.
launch.zh: 该机构计划发射一颗新卫星来研究海洋。

launch.en: The launch of the campaign attracted wide attention from the national press.
launch.zh: 这项运动的启动引起了全国媒体的广泛关注。

emerge.en: New forms of writing emerged as trade spread across the region.
emerge.zh: 随着贸易在该地区的扩展,新的文字形式出现了。

arise.en: Problems can arise when a new species is brought into an area.
arise.zh: 把新物种引入某个地区时可能出现问题。

occur.en: Most earthquakes occur along the edges of the Earth's major plates.
occur.zh: 大多数地震发生在地球主要板块的边缘。

evolve.en: Birds are thought to have evolved from small meat-eating dinosaurs.
evolve.zh: 人们认为鸟类是从小型食肉恐龙进化而来的。

develop.en: Children develop their reading skills at different speeds.
develop.zh: 孩子们阅读能力的发展速度各不相同。

accumulate.en: Harmful chemicals can accumulate in the bodies of large fish.
accumulate.zh: 有害化学物质可能在大型鱼类体内积累。

sustain.en: The land could no longer sustain such a large population.
sustain.zh: 这片土地再也无法维持这么多人口。

retain.en: Clay soils retain water far better than sandy ones.
retain.zh: 黏土的保水能力远远强于沙土。

preserve.en: The cold, dry air of the cave helped to preserve the paintings.
preserve.zh: 洞穴寒冷干燥的空气有助于保存这些壁画。

conserve.en: Many desert plants have small leaves in order to conserve water.
conserve.zh: 许多沙漠植物的叶子很小,以节约水分。

protect.en: Thick fur protects the animal from the extreme cold of the Arctic.
protect.zh: 厚厚的皮毛保护这种动物免受北极的严寒。

ensure.en: Regular inspections ensure that the water remains safe to drink.
ensure.zh: 定期检查确保水质仍可安全饮用。

secure.en: The company secured funding to develop its new battery technology.
secure.zh: 该公司获得了资金,用于开发新电池技术。

secure.en: Most people want a secure job that offers a regular income.
secure.zh: 大多数人都想要一份收入稳定的安稳工作。

acknowledge.en: The author acknowledges that the sample used in the study was small.
acknowledge.zh: 作者承认这项研究使用的样本量很小。

recognise.en: Her work was not recognised until many years after her death.
recognise.zh: 她的成果直到她去世多年后才得到认可。

perceive.en: Humans perceive colour through special cells at the back of the eye.
perceive.zh: 人类通过眼睛后部的特殊细胞感知颜色。

regard.en: Many historians regard this as the most important battle of the war.
regard.zh: 许多历史学家把这场战役看作这场战争中最重要的一场。

consider.en: Planners must consider the needs of older residents when designing new towns.
consider.zh: 规划者在设计新城镇时必须考虑老年居民的需求。

specify.en: The rules specify how much waste each factory may release.
specify.zh: 规定具体说明了每家工厂可以排放多少废物。

clarify.en: Further tests are needed to clarify the cause of the illness.
clarify.zh: 需要进一步检查来澄清病因。

summarise.en: The final chapter summarises the main findings of the research.
summarise.zh: 最后一章总结了这项研究的主要发现。

compile.en: Scholars spent decades compiling the first complete dictionary of the language.
compile.zh: 学者们花了几十年编纂这种语言的第一部完整词典。

integrate.en: The new system integrates information from several different sources.
integrate.zh: 新系统整合了来自多个不同来源的信息。

incorporate.en: Modern buildings often incorporate features that reduce their use of energy.
incorporate.zh: 现代建筑常常融入一些减少能耗的设计。

combine.en: Tin and copper were combined to produce a much harder metal.
combine.zh: 锡和铜结合后产生了一种硬度高得多的金属。

merge.en: Two small colleges merged to form the new university in 1965.
merge.zh: 两所小学院于 1965 年合并,组成了这所新大学。

separate.en: The machine separates the seeds from the rest of the plant.
separate.zh: 这台机器把种子从植株的其他部分分离出来。

distinguish.en: Babies can distinguish their mother's voice from those of other people.
distinguish.zh: 婴儿能把母亲的声音和其他人的声音区分开。

differentiate.en: This feature helps scientists to differentiate between the two species.
differentiate.zh: 这一特征有助于科学家区分这两个物种。

compare.en: The study compares the health of people in rural and urban areas.
compare.zh: 这项研究比较了农村和城市居民的健康状况。

contrast.en: The author contrasts life in the village with life in the modern city.
contrast.zh: 作者把乡村生活和现代城市生活作了对比。

contrast.en: There is a sharp contrast between the wet east and the dry west.
contrast.zh: 潮湿的东部和干燥的西部形成鲜明对比。

resemble.en: Some harmless insects have evolved to resemble more dangerous species.
resemble.zh: 一些无害的昆虫进化得与更危险的物种相似。

coincide.en: The arrival of the birds coincides with the appearance of certain insects.
coincide.zh: 这些鸟到来的时间恰好与某些昆虫出现的时间相同。

correspond.en: The dates in the diary correspond closely with those in official records.
correspond.zh: 日记中的日期与官方记录基本相符。

depend-on.en: The health of the forest will depend on the amount of rain it receives.
depend-on.zh: 森林的健康将取决于它获得的雨量。

rely-on.en: Many small islands rely on tourism for most of their income.
rely-on.zh: 许多小岛的大部分收入依赖旅游业。

involve.en: Learning to read involves several different areas of the brain.
involve.zh: 学习阅读涉及大脑的多个不同区域。

entail.en: Moving the whole village would entail enormous cost and disruption.
entail.zh: 搬迁整个村庄必然涉及巨大的成本和混乱。

require.en: Most tropical plants require high levels of light and water.
require.zh: 大多数热带植物需要充足的光照和水分。

demand.en: Local residents demanded better protection from the floods.
demand.zh: 当地居民要求加强防洪保护。

demand.en: Demand for electricity is highest in the early evening.
demand.zh: 傍晚时分的电力需求最高。

exploit.en: Companies have begun to exploit the mineral resources under the ice.
exploit.zh: 公司已开始开发冰层下的矿产资源。

exploit.en: Factory owners were accused of exploiting young workers in the nineteenth century.
exploit.zh: 十九世纪的工厂主被指控剥削年轻工人。

utilise.en: Solar panels utilise energy from the sun to produce electricity.
utilise.zh: 太阳能电池板利用太阳的能量发电。

employ.en: The factory once employed more than half of the people in the town.
employ.zh: 这家工厂曾雇用镇上一半以上的人。

employ.en: The researchers employed a new method to measure the age of the rocks.
employ.zh: 研究者使用了一种新方法测定岩石的年龄。

apply.en: The same principle can be applied to the design of aircraft wings.
apply.zh: 同样的原理可以应用于飞机机翼的设计。

apply.en: Farmers can apply for government grants to plant new forests.
apply.zh: 农民可以申请政府补助来种植新的森林。

distribute.en: The charity distributes food to families in the areas worst affected.
distribute.zh: 这家慈善机构向受灾最严重地区的家庭分发食物。

assign.en: Participants were asked to assign a score to each of the images.
assign.zh: 参与者被要求给每张图片打分。

delegate.en: Good managers delegate routine tasks so they can focus on planning.
delegate.zh: 优秀的管理者会把日常工作委派出去,以便专注于规划。

delegate.en: Each country sent a delegate to the conference on climate change.
delegate.zh: 每个国家都派了一名代表参加气候变化会议。

monitor.en: Satellites are used to monitor changes in the size of the ice sheets.
monitor.zh: 卫星被用来监控冰盖面积的变化。

regulate.en: The skin helps to regulate the temperature of the body.

supervise.en: Experienced staff supervise the students during their first year of training.
supervise.zh: 培训的第一年,由有经验的员工监督学生。

inspect.en: Officials inspect the factory twice a year to check the air quality.
inspect.zh: 官员每年两次检查工厂的空气质量。

detect.en: Some sharks can detect a tiny amount of blood in the water.
detect.zh: 有些鲨鱼能在水中检测到极少量的血液。

discover.en: Marie Curie discovered two new elements during her research in Paris.
discover.zh: 玛丽·居里在巴黎进行研究时发现了两种新元素。

invent.en: No one knows exactly who invented the first wheel.
invent.zh: 没有人确切知道最早的轮子是谁发明的。

devise.en: Engineers have devised a way of removing salt from seawater more cheaply.
devise.zh: 工程师想出了一种更便宜的海水淡化方法。

design.en: The building was designed to use as little energy as possible.
design.zh: 这座建筑的设计目的是尽量少用能源。

formulate.en: Scientists formulate a hypothesis before they begin an experiment.
formulate.zh: 科学家在开始实验前先提出假设。

revise.en: Scientists had to revise their estimates after the new data arrived.
revise.zh: 新数据到来后,科学家不得不修订他们的估算。

update.en: The database is updated every week with information from local hospitals.
update.zh: 数据库每周根据当地医院的信息更新一次。

abandon.en: Many farmers were forced to abandon their land during the long drought.
abandon.zh: 在长期干旱期间,许多农民被迫放弃土地。

neglect.en: For many years, governments tended to neglect the needs of rural areas.
neglect.zh: 多年来,政府往往忽视农村地区的需求。

ignore.en: Early reports of the disease were largely ignored by the authorities.
ignore.zh: 关于这种疾病的早期报告大多被当局忽略了。

overlook.en: Researchers often overlook the role that women played in early farming.
overlook.zh: 研究者常常忽视女性在早期农业中的作用。

overlook.en: The ancient fort overlooks the river from the top of a steep hill.
overlook.zh: 这座古堡位于陡峭的山顶,俯瞰着河流。

underestimate.en: People often underestimate how long it takes to form a new habit.
underestimate.zh: 人们常常低估养成新习惯所需的时间。

overestimate.en: Drivers tend to overestimate their own ability behind the wheel.
overestimate.zh: 司机往往高估自己的驾驶能力。

exaggerate.en: Newspapers sometimes exaggerate the risks of new technology to attract readers.
exaggerate.zh: 报纸有时夸大新技术的风险来吸引读者。

anticipate.en: Few experts anticipated how quickly the internet would change society.
anticipate.zh: 很少有专家预料到互联网会如此迅速地改变社会。

foresee.en: It is impossible to foresee all the effects of a new technology.
foresee.zh: 不可能预见一项新技术的所有影响。

confront.en: Coastal cities must now confront the problem of rising sea levels.
confront.zh: 沿海城市现在必须面对海平面上升的问题。

encounter.en: Early explorers encountered many animals that they had never seen before.
encounter.zh: 早期探险家遇到了许多从未见过的动物。

undergo.en: Caterpillars undergo a complete change of form as they become butterflies.
undergo.zh: 毛毛虫在变成蝴蝶的过程中要经历完全的形态变化。

endure.en: Workers on the railway had to endure extreme heat and disease.
endure.zh: 铁路工人不得不忍受酷热和疾病。

withstand.en: The new buildings are designed to withstand strong earthquakes.
withstand.zh: 新建筑的设计能够承受强烈地震。

resist.en: Some crops have been bred to resist common insects and diseases.
resist.zh: 一些作物经过培育,能够抵抗常见的虫害和疾病。

tolerate.en: Few fish can tolerate such high levels of salt in the water.
tolerate.zh: 很少有鱼能忍受水中这么高的盐度。

compensate.en: Blind people may develop better hearing to compensate for their loss of sight.
compensate.zh: 盲人的听力可能会变得更好,以弥补视力的丧失。

contribute.en: Local people contributed money and labour to build the new school.
contribute.zh: 当地人为建造新学校贡献了资金和劳力。

participate.en: More than two thousand volunteers agreed to participate in the study.
participate.zh: 两千多名志愿者同意参与这项研究。

cooperate.en: Wolves cooperate with each other when hunting large animals.
cooperate.zh: 狼在捕猎大型动物时互相合作。

collaborate.en: Scientists from twelve countries collaborated on the project.
collaborate.zh: 来自十二个国家的科学家在这个项目上开展了协作。

interact.en: Babies learn language by interacting with the people around them.
interact.zh: 婴儿通过与周围的人互动来学习语言。

communicate.en: Elephants communicate over long distances using very low sounds.
communicate.zh: 大象利用极低的声音进行远距离交流。

negotiate.en: The two countries negotiated a treaty to share water from the river.
negotiate.zh: 两国通过谈判达成了一项共享河水的条约。

advocate.en: Many doctors advocate a diet rich in vegetables and whole grains.
advocate.zh: 许多医生提倡多吃蔬菜和全谷物的饮食。

advocate.en: She was a strong advocate of equal education for girls.
advocate.zh: 她是女孩平等受教育的坚定提倡者。

oppose.en: Local farmers strongly oppose the plan to build an airport on their land.
oppose.zh: 当地农民强烈反对在他们的土地上建机场的计划。

object-to-doing-sth.en: Many residents object to paying higher taxes for the new stadium.
object-to-doing-sth.zh: 许多居民反对为新体育场缴纳更高的税。

favour.en: Most of the experts favour a gradual approach to changing the system.
favour.zh: 大多数专家支持逐步改革这一体系。

justify.en: The results do not justify the high cost of the treatment.
justify.zh: 这样的结果不足以证明高昂的治疗费用是合理的。

convince.en: It took years to convince other scientists that the theory was correct.
convince.zh: 花了多年时间才让其他科学家相信这一理论是正确的。

persuade.en: Campaigns have failed to persuade many young people to stop smoking.
persuade.zh: 宣传活动未能说服许多年轻人戒烟。

elevate.en: Stress can elevate blood pressure and increase the risk of heart disease.
elevate.zh: 压力会使血压升高,增加患心脏病的风险。

exert.en: Climate exerts a strong influence on where early farming communities developed.
exert.zh: 早期农耕社群在哪里发展起来,很大程度上受气候影响。

expedite.en: New software has helped to expedite the process of checking medical records.
expedite.zh: 新软件加快了核对病历的流程。

originate.en: The custom is thought to originate from an ancient harvest festival.
originate.zh: 这一习俗被认为起源于一个古老的丰收节。

disclose.en: Companies are now required to disclose how much carbon they produce.
disclose.zh: 现在公司被要求披露自己的碳排放量。

distort.en: The curved surface of the Earth tends to distort flat maps.
distort.zh: 地球的曲面往往会使平面地图变形。

imitate.en: Young birds learn to sing by imitating the songs of adult males.
imitate.zh: 幼鸟通过模仿成年雄鸟的歌声来学习鸣叫。

dominate.en: A few large companies now dominate the global market for seeds.
dominate.zh: 现在少数几家大公司主导着全球种子市场。

popularise.en: Television programmes helped to popularise science among ordinary people.
popularise.zh: 电视节目帮助在普通人中普及科学。

convey.en: Facial expressions can convey emotions that words cannot express.
convey.zh: 面部表情可以传达言语无法表达的情感。

convey.en: Long stone channels were built to convey water to the city.
convey.zh: 人们修建了长长的石渠,把水运送到城市。

deserve.en: Many believe that the scientist deserves more credit for this discovery.
deserve.zh: 许多人认为,这位科学家应该因这一发现得到更多赞誉。

affirm.en: The results of the study affirm the value of early education.
affirm.zh: 这项研究的结果肯定了早期教育的价值。

assure.en: The authorities assured residents that the water was safe to drink.
assure.zh: 当局向居民保证,这些水可以安全饮用。

substantiate.en: There is little data to substantiate the claims made by the company.
substantiate.zh: 几乎没有数据能证实该公司的说法。

stipulate.en: The agreement stipulates that the land must be used only for farming.
stipulate.zh: 协议规定,这片土地只能用于耕作。

observe.en: Researchers observed the behaviour of the monkeys for over ten years.
observe.zh: 研究者观察这些猴子的行为长达十多年。

observe.en: All ships must observe the rules that protect the marine park.
observe.zh: 所有船只都必须遵守保护海洋公园的规定。

abide-by.en: Member countries agreed to abide by the rules set out in the treaty.
abide-by.zh: 成员国同意遵守条约中规定的规则。

consume.en: Large data centres consume enormous amounts of electricity every year.
consume.zh: 大型数据中心每年消耗大量电力。

consolidate.en: Sleep appears to consolidate new memories formed during the day.
consolidate.zh: 睡眠似乎能巩固白天形成的新记忆。

ascend.en: Warm air ascends and cools as it moves higher above the ground.
ascend.zh: 暖空气上升,离地面越高温度越低。

instil.en: Parents can instil good reading habits in children from an early age.
instil.zh: 父母可以从小给孩子灌输良好的阅读习惯。

enlighten.en: Public lectures were intended to enlighten ordinary people about recent discoveries.
enlighten.zh: 公开讲座旨在向普通人介绍最新发现,启发他们。

transpire.en: It later transpired that the data had been recorded incorrectly.
transpire.zh: 后来得知,这些数据记录有误。

transpire.en: Plants transpire more water on hot and windy days.
transpire.zh: 植物在炎热多风的日子里蒸腾的水分更多。

reinforce.en: Repeating information at intervals helps to reinforce it in the memory.
reinforce.zh: 间隔重复信息有助于加深记忆。

confine.en: The disease was confined to a small area in the south of the country.
confine.zh: 这种疾病被限制在该国南部的一小片地区。

depict.en: The paintings depict scenes from everyday life in ancient Rome.
depict.zh: 这些画描绘了古罗马日常生活的场景。

render.en: Heavy flooding rendered the main road impossible to use.
render.zh: 严重的洪水使主干道无法通行。

undermine.en: Rising costs could undermine the success of the entire programme.
undermine.zh: 不断上升的成本可能削弱整个项目的成效。

scatter.en: Birds help to scatter the seeds of many forest plants.
scatter.zh: 鸟类帮助散布许多森林植物的种子。

interfere.en: Bright lights can interfere with the sleep patterns of city residents.
interfere.zh: 明亮的灯光可能妨碍城市居民的睡眠规律。

grasp.en: Young children often find it hard to grasp the idea of time.
grasp.zh: 幼儿常常很难理解时间的概念。

manipulate.en: Octopuses can manipulate objects with great skill using their long arms.
manipulate.zh: 章鱼能用长长的腕灵巧地操纵物体。

activate.en: The sensor will activate the alarm if the water level rises too high.
activate.zh: 水位过高时,传感器会启动警报。

elaborate.en: The author does not elaborate on how the data was collected.
elaborate.zh: 作者没有详细阐述数据是如何收集的。

elaborate.en: The male bird builds an elaborate nest to attract a female.
elaborate.zh: 雄鸟筑起精致的巢来吸引雌鸟。

coordinate.en: A central office coordinates the work of all the local health teams.
coordinate.zh: 中央办公室协调各地卫生团队的工作。

overlap.en: The ranges of the two species overlap in the north of the country.
overlap.zh: 这两个物种的分布范围在该国北部重叠。

simplify.en: The new form was designed to simplify the process of applying for aid.
simplify.zh: 新表格的设计是为了简化申请援助的流程。

standardise.en: The government tried to standardise the spelling of the national language.
standardise.zh: 政府试图统一这种国语的拼写。

vary.en: Average temperatures vary greatly from one part of the country to another.
vary.zh: 全国各地的平均气温差异很大。

declare.en: The government declared a national emergency after the earthquake.
declare.zh: 地震后,政府宣布全国进入紧急状态。

capture.en: Cameras in the forest captured images of the rare animal at night.
capture.zh: 森林里的相机在夜间捕捉到了这种珍稀动物的影像。

rely.en: Many of these communities rely heavily on fishing for their food.
rely.zh: 这些社区中有许多在食物上严重依赖捕鱼。

derive.en: Plants derive most of their energy from sunlight.
derive.zh: 植物的大部分能量来自阳光。

bind.en: The treaty will bind all member countries to reducing their carbon emissions.
bind.zh: 这项条约将约束所有成员国减少碳排放。

permit.en: Local laws do not permit building within a hundred metres of the shore.
permit.zh: 当地法律不允许在距海岸一百米以内建房。

permit.en: Visitors must obtain a permit before they enter the protected area.
permit.zh: 游客进入保护区前必须获得许可证。

embrace.en: Many older workers have been quick to embrace new technology.
embrace.zh: 许多年纪较大的员工很快就接受了新技术。

overcome.en: Engineers had to overcome many difficulties to build the tunnel.
overcome.zh: 工程师必须克服许多困难才能建成这条隧道。

cease.en: The volcano ceased to be active about two thousand years ago.
cease.zh: 这座火山大约两千年前就停止了活动。

strengthen.en: Regular exercise can strengthen the bones and reduce the risk of falls.
strengthen.zh: 经常锻炼可以强健骨骼,降低跌倒的风险。

consult.en: Patients should consult a doctor before taking any new medicine.
consult.zh: 服用任何新药前,患者都应该咨询医生。

devote.en: She devoted her whole career to the study of African birds.
devote.zh: 她把整个职业生涯都投入到非洲鸟类的研究之中。

dedicate.en: The institute will dedicate most of its budget to cancer research.
dedicate.zh: 该研究所将把大部分预算投入癌症研究。

provoke.en: The plan to close the hospital provoked angry protests from local residents.
provoke.zh: 关闭医院的计划引起了当地居民的愤怒抗议。

assemble.en: Workers assemble the parts in a large factory near the port.
assemble.zh: 工人在港口附近的一家大工厂组装这些零件。

allege.en: Critics allege that the company ignored safety warnings for many years.
allege.zh: 批评者声称该公司多年来无视安全警告。

envisage.en: The plan envisages a network of cycle paths across the whole city.
envisage.zh: 该计划设想在全市建立自行车道网络。

concede.en: Even its supporters concede that the policy has been expensive.
concede.zh: 连这项政策的支持者也承认它花费很大。

endorse.en: The national medical association has endorsed the new treatment.
endorse.zh: 全国医学协会已经认可了这种新疗法。

contemplate.en: Few people at that time would contemplate travelling so far from home.
contemplate.zh: 当时很少有人会考虑去离家这么远的地方。

diminish.en: The fear of flying tends to diminish with more experience.
diminish.zh: 随着经验增加,对飞行的恐惧往往会减弱。

incur.en: Countries that break the agreement may incur heavy financial penalties.
incur.zh: 违反协议的国家可能招致高额罚款。

oversee.en: A small committee was set up to oversee the work of the project.
oversee.zh: 成立了一个小型委员会来监督这个项目的工作。

deem.en: The water in the lake was deemed unsafe for swimming.
deem.zh: 这个湖的水被认为不适合游泳。

compel.en: Rising costs may compel many farmers to sell their land.
compel.zh: 不断上涨的成本可能迫使许多农民出售土地。

omit.en: The early maps omit many of the smaller islands in the region.
omit.zh: 早期地图遗漏了该地区的许多小岛。

halt.en: The government halted work on the dam after protests by local farmers.
halt.zh: 在当地农民抗议后,政府叫停了大坝工程。

proclaim.en: The new government was quick to proclaim the country's independence.
proclaim.zh: 新政府很快就宣告了国家独立。

suppress.en: Some medicines suppress the body's natural response to infection.
suppress.zh: 有些药物会抑制身体对感染的自然反应。

summon.en: The king summoned his advisers to discuss the threat of invasion.
summon.zh: 国王召集大臣们商讨入侵的威胁。

revive.en: Efforts are being made to revive the language among younger speakers.
revive.zh: 人们正在努力让这种语言在年轻人中复兴。

boast.en: The city boasts one of the finest collections of Roman art in Europe.
boast.zh: 这座城市拥有欧洲最好的罗马艺术藏品之一。

unfold.en: Events began to unfold quickly once the new king came to power.
unfold.zh: 新国王掌权后,事态开始迅速发展。

arouse.en: The strange discovery aroused great interest among scientists around the world.
arouse.zh: 这一奇特的发现引起了世界各地科学家的极大兴趣。

thrive.en: These plants thrive in warm conditions with plenty of water.
thrive.zh: 这些植物在温暖、水分充足的环境中茁壮成长。

speculate.en: Researchers can only speculate about why the city was abandoned.
speculate.zh: 研究者只能推测这座城市被遗弃的原因。

conform.en: Children often feel pressure to conform to the behaviour of their friends.
conform.zh: 孩子们常常感到要与朋友的行为保持一致的压力。

divert.en: Engineers built a channel to divert water away from the town.
divert.zh: 工程师修建了一条水渠,把水从镇上引开。

evoke.en: Certain smells can evoke strong memories of childhood.
evoke.zh: 某些气味能唤起强烈的童年记忆。

penetrate.en: Very little sunlight can penetrate to the bottom of the deep ocean.
penetrate.zh: 很少有阳光能穿透到深海底部。

strive.en: Scientists continue to strive for a better understanding of the brain.
strive.zh: 科学家继续努力更好地理解大脑。

embody.en: These old buildings embody the values of the people who built them.
embody.zh: 这些老建筑体现了建造者的价值观。

disrupt.en: Even small changes in temperature can disrupt the life cycle of insects.
disrupt.zh: 即使温度的微小变化,也可能扰乱昆虫的生命周期。

uphold.en: Courts are expected to uphold the law regardless of public opinion.
uphold.zh: 无论舆论如何,法院都应维护法律。

illuminate.en: The study helps to illuminate how memories are stored in the brain.
illuminate.zh: 这项研究有助于阐明记忆是如何储存在大脑中的。

discard.en: Most of the fish caught by the boats are discarded as unwanted.
discard.zh: 船只捕捞的大部分鱼都被当作不需要的东西丢弃了。

reconcile.en: It is difficult to reconcile economic growth with protecting the environment.
reconcile.zh: 很难调和经济增长与环境保护之间的矛盾。

defy.en: The behaviour of these tiny particles seems to defy explanation.
defy.zh: 这些微小粒子的行为似乎无法解释。

notify.en: Hospitals must notify the authorities of any new cases of the disease.
notify.zh: 医院必须把任何新病例通知有关部门。

offset.en: Planting trees may partly offset the carbon released by air travel.
offset.zh: 植树也许能部分抵消航空旅行排放的碳。

manifest.en: The disease may not manifest itself until many years after infection.
manifest.zh: 这种疾病可能在感染多年后才显现出来。

ascertain.en: Investigators were unable to ascertain the exact cause of the fire.
ascertain.zh: 调查人员无法查明火灾的确切原因。

expel.en: The lungs expel carbon dioxide from the body with each breath.
expel.zh: 肺每次呼吸都把二氧化碳排出体外。

adhere.en: Many patients fail to adhere to the treatment plan given by their doctor.
adhere.zh: 许多患者未能坚持医生给出的治疗方案。

safeguard.en: New laws were passed to safeguard the rights of workers.
safeguard.zh: 新法律的通过是为了保护工人的权利。

culminate.en: Years of protest culminated in a change in the law in 1928.
culminate.zh: 多年的抗议最终以 1928 年法律的修改告终。

intensify.en: Competition for water intensified as the population of the valley grew.
intensify.zh: 随着山谷人口增长,对水资源的争夺加剧了。

enrich.en: Rotting leaves enrich the soil with valuable nutrients.
enrich.zh: 腐烂的树叶为土壤补充了宝贵的养分。

elicit.en: The researchers used pictures to elicit responses from very young children.
elicit.zh: 研究者用图片引导幼儿作出回应。

transcend.en: Great music can transcend differences of language and culture.
transcend.zh: 伟大的音乐能够超越语言和文化的差异。

withhold.en: The government threatened to withhold funding from schools that broke the rules.
withhold.zh: 政府威胁要扣留违规学校的经费。

displace.en: The new dam will displace thousands of people living along the river.
displace.zh: 新大坝将迫使沿河的数千人离开家园。

exacerbate.en: Cutting down forests can exacerbate the effects of heavy rain.
exacerbate.zh: 砍伐森林会加剧暴雨的影响。

necessitate.en: The growth of the city will necessitate a new water supply.
necessitate.zh: 城市的发展使得新的供水系统成为必要。

exemplify.en: These gardens exemplify the Japanese love of simplicity and balance.
exemplify.zh: 这些花园是日本人崇尚简约与平衡的典型例子。

impair.en: Too little sleep can impair judgement as much as alcohol.
impair.zh: 睡眠过少对判断力的损害与酒精一样大。

reclaim.en: The Dutch have reclaimed large areas of land from the sea.
reclaim.zh: 荷兰人从海中开垦了大片土地。

disregard.en: Some factories continued to disregard the rules on waste disposal.
disregard.zh: 一些工厂继续无视废物处理的规定。

detach.en: Part of the glacier may detach and fall into the sea.
detach.zh: 部分冰川可能脱离并坠入海中。

escalate.en: Small disagreements over water can quickly escalate into serious conflict.
escalate.zh: 关于水的小分歧可能很快升级为严重冲突。

avert.en: Early action helped to avert a serious shortage of food.
avert.zh: 及早采取行动有助于避免严重的粮食短缺。

bypass.en: The new road will bypass the town and reduce traffic in the centre.
bypass.zh: 新公路将绕过小镇,减少市中心的交通流量。

discern.en: It is difficult to discern any pattern in such a small set of data.
discern.zh: 在这么小的数据集中,很难察觉出任何规律。

ascribe.en: Early people often ascribed natural disasters to the anger of the gods.
ascribe.zh: 早期的人们常常把自然灾害归因于神的愤怒。

heighten.en: Caffeine can heighten alertness for several hours after it is taken.
heighten.zh: 摄入咖啡因后的几小时内,人的警觉性会提高。

commend.en: The report commends the school for its work with disabled children.
commend.zh: 报告称赞这所学校在帮助残障儿童方面所做的工作。

succumb.en: Many of the settlers succumbed to disease during their first winter.
succumb.zh: 许多定居者在第一个冬天死于疾病。

intrigue.en: The unusual shape of the bones continues to intrigue scientists.
intrigue.zh: 这些骨头不同寻常的形状一直引起科学家的兴趣。

tighten.en: The government plans to tighten controls on the use of plastic bags.
tighten.zh: 政府计划加强对塑料袋使用的管制。

enclose.en: Farmers began to enclose their fields with stone walls in the 1700s.
enclose.zh: 18 世纪,农民开始用石墙把田地围起来。

reassure.en: The government tried to reassure the public that the food was safe.
reassure.zh: 政府试图让公众放心,告诉他们这些食品是安全的。

situate.en: Planners decided to situate the new factory far from the river.
situate.zh: 规划者决定把新工厂建在远离河流的地方。

steer.en: The new policy aims to steer young people towards careers in science.
steer.zh: 新政策旨在引导年轻人从事科学领域的职业。

intimidate.en: Larger males use loud calls to intimidate their rivals.
intimidate.zh: 体型较大的雄性用响亮的叫声恐吓对手。

restrain.en: Interest rates were raised to restrain the rapid growth in spending.
restrain.zh: 提高利率是为了抑制支出的快速增长。

resume.en: Work on the bridge will resume once the river level has fallen.
resume.zh: 河水水位下降后,桥梁工程将重新开始。

forge.en: The two towns forged close links through trade and marriage.
forge.zh: 这两个城镇通过贸易和联姻建立了密切的联系。

forge.en: The criminals had forged documents to sell the land illegally.
forge.zh: 这些罪犯伪造了文件,非法出售土地。

inflict.en: Strong winds can inflict serious damage on buildings along the coast.
inflict.zh: 强风可能给沿海建筑造成严重破坏。

betray.en: A slight change in the voice can betray a person's true feelings.
betray.zh: 声音的细微变化可能泄露一个人的真实情感。

endeavour.en: Scientific endeavour depends on the free exchange of ideas between researchers.
endeavour.zh: 科学上的努力有赖于研究者之间自由交流思想。

excel.en: Some children excel at mathematics but struggle to read.
excel.zh: 有些孩子擅长数学,却在阅读上很吃力。

dwell.en: Around a thousand people dwell in caves cut into the soft rock.
dwell.zh: 大约有一千人居住在软岩中开凿的洞穴里。

mobilise.en: The government mobilised thousands of volunteers to help after the flood.
mobilise.zh: 洪水过后,政府动员了数千名志愿者提供帮助。

suspend.en: The trial of the drug was suspended after several patients became ill.
suspend.zh: 几名患者生病后,这种药物的试验被暂停。

reverse.en: Scientists doubt whether the damage to the reef can be reversed.
reverse.zh: 科学家怀疑珊瑚礁受到的损害能否逆转。

reverse.en: The second study produced exactly the reverse result.
reverse.zh: 第二项研究得出了完全相反的结果。

vanish.en: Many species of frog could vanish completely within the next few decades.
vanish.zh: 许多种类的青蛙可能在未来几十年内完全消失。

fade.en: Colours in old paintings gradually fade when they are exposed to light.
fade.zh: 古画的颜色在光照下会逐渐褪去。

shrink.en: The size of the glacier has continued to shrink in recent decades.
shrink.zh: 近几十年来,这条冰川的面积持续缩小。

split.en: The company split into two separate businesses in the early 1990s.
split.zh: 这家公司在 20 世纪 90 年代初分裂成两家独立的企业。

pose.en: Plastic waste poses a serious danger to sea birds and turtles.
pose.zh: 塑料垃圾对海鸟和海龟构成严重危险。

tap.en: Engineers hope to tap the heat stored deep under the ground.
tap.zh: 工程师希望开发利用地下深处储存的热能。

leap.en: The invention of the telescope was a great leap forward for astronomy.
leap.zh: 望远镜的发明是天文学的一次巨大飞跃。

rescue.en: Volunteers worked through the night to rescue birds caught in the oil.
rescue.zh: 志愿者彻夜营救被石油困住的鸟类。
